items.name: Shortsword
items.description: These blades come in a variety of shapes and styles, but they are typically 2 feet long.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

generalAbilities.name: At-Will Spells
generalAbilities.description:
See rules...

The monster can cast its at-will spells any number of times without using up spell slots.

defensiveAbilities.name: Final Fate
defensiveAbilities.description:
When the hunter dies, their soul leaves their body in an explosion of spiritual energy. All creatures in a 20ft Burst take 5d6 Spirit Damage damage (Basic DC 19 Will Saving Throw save).

The hunter's possessions are left in a pile where they died.

defensiveAbilities.name: Light Blindness
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

When first exposed to bright light, the monster is Blinded until the end of its next turn. After this exposure, light doesn't blind the monster again until after it spends 1 hour in darkness. However, as long as the monster is in an area of bright light, it's Dazzled.

offensiveAbilities.name: Double Slice
offensiveAbilities.description: The caligni hunter makes two Strikes against the same target, one with each of their shortswords. The hunter combines the damage of any attacks that hit and applies precision damage, resistances, and weaknesses only once. Both attacks count toward the hunter's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty increases only after both attacks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Encircling Command
offensiveAbilities.description: Each caligni skulker within 30 feet of the skulker can Step. Each creeper can benefit from Encircling Command only once per round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: The caligni hunter deals 1d6 extra precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

cantrips.name: Figment
cantrips.description: You create a simple illusory sound or vision. A sound adds the auditory trait to the spell and the sound can't include intelligible words or elaborate music. A vision adds the visual trait, can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and is clearly crude and undetailed if viewed from within 15 feet. When you Cast or Sustain the Spell, you can attempt to Create a Diversion with the illusion, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception check. If the attempt fails against a creature, that creature disbelieves the figment.

lv2spells.name: Darkness (At Will)
lv2spells.description:
You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as Concealed.

lv2spells.name: See the Unseen (At Will)
lv2spells.description:
Your gaze pierces through illusions and finds Invisible creatures and spirits. You can see invisible creatures as though they weren't invisible, although their features are blurred, making them Concealed and difficult to identify. You can also see incorporeal creatures, like ghosts, phased through an object from within 10 feet of an object's surface as blurry shapes seen through those objects. Subtler clues also grant you a +2 status bonus to checks you make to disbelieve illusions.

Heightened (5th) This spell has a duration of 8 hours.
